svg.title: Five rules for money
svg.desc: 1. Money is an integer: store cents as an int64 plus a currency code, never a float. 2. Money is never created or destroyed: record every movement twice; balances are derived, never overwritten. 3. Every request can arrive twice: idempotency keys, so a retry replays the answer, never the payment. 4. Concurrent requests can't overspend: lock the rows, always in the same order. 5. A crash can happen between any two lines: sagas that resume, a transactional outbox, idempotent consumers.
svg.text: What payment code can never get wrong
